observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Large outdoor stage at night with colorful stage lighting and a seated live band in the center background, part of the Heiva i Tahiti festival.
observation.dancers: Large group of mixed men and women, with some featured soloists dancing near the center.
observation.formation_and_space: Massive group arranged in a large U-shape or semicircle around the central band and soloists, with dancers kneeling or sitting in rows and some moving around the central performance area.
observation.posture: Upright posture with soft knees, weight shifting between feet for the soloists while seated dancers maintain upright torsos.
observation.footwork: Rapid stepping and weight shifts on the beats for the dancing soloists, while the large seated group performs upper body and arm movements without footwork.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms and hands move expressively, sometimes holding green fronds or leafy objects, raised above the head or extended to the sides.
observation.hips_and_torso: Active hip rotations and side-to-side movements by the soloists, while seated dancers rotate hips and torso subtly.
observation.partnering: Soloists dance near each other without sustained physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Dancers transition between kneeling/seated levels and standing upright, with occasional small turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style costumes featuring feathered headdresses, fringed straw or bark skirts (moreu), shell necklaces, and leaf fronds held in hands.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and micro-weight shifts are obscured by wide camera angles and rapid group motion.

signature_moments.what: A female soloist performs rapid hip shimmies and arm gestures while standing among kneeling group dancers.
A male and female soloist dance side-by-side with energetic hip movements and raised arm gestures holding leafy fronds.
Soloists execute coordinated rapid stepping and hip rotations in front of the seated musicians.
